A '''steel dolabra''' is the [[Steel equipment|steel]] [[dolabra]], made by smithing an [[Iron Axe|iron axe]] with [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]]. It mines at speed 7 and has 3000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_dolabra.json}}</ref>

As a [[dolabra]], it works as both a pickaxe and an axe, at a lower mining speed than the steel pickaxe or axe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot, which is not used up. The recipe matches the base by item ID, so a iron dolabra works as the base as well as an iron axe; without the template the same base and alloy make a [[Steel Axe|steel axe]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/steel/dolabra</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 7.

Its tool rules have no obsidian restriction, so it mines obsidian with drops at its normal speed, although the [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.1-alpha|1.12.1-alpha]] notes say only diamond, electrum and adamant tools can mine obsidian.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/steel_dolabra.json}}</ref>

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 6 damage with an attack speed of 0.9.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Added translation support for all armor and tools.}}
{{History line|0.6-alpha|Added recipe unlocks for steel equipment.}}
{{History line|1.02|Steel alloy takes less time to blast.}}
{{History line|1.03|Steel alloy is now blasted from [[Carbon-Rich Iron|carbon-rich iron]] instead of directly from iron. The steel dolabra's real attack speed now matches its tooltip.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Dolabras were redefined as axe (tool) and pickaxe hybrids rather than weapons: damage goes down and weapon intrinsics are removed over time.}}
}}
